response.original_title: 【FAQs Guide】How do I change room on Holland America Cruise?
response.overview: To change your room on a Holland America Cruise, call or contact Holland America Line customer service at ☎︎ +1-866-829-1280 (US) or ☎︎ +61-1800-009-384 (AUS) & ☎︎ +44-204-586-5316 (UK). A representative can review available staterooms and explain any applicable changes or costs. Holland America notes that ☎︎ +1-866-829-1280 (US) changing a stateroom after a deposit may require canceling the existing booking before making the new reservation.  You can change your room on a Holland America cruise online through the Holland America Cruise Manager or by calling customer service at 1-800-Holland America (☎︎ +1-866-829-1280 (US).Log into your Holland America account, open your booking via the Cruise Manager or Edit Booking section, and check for an upgrade or stateroom modification option.
